title: Subordination of discrete snakes
summary: Motivated by applications in random geometry, we investigate the notion of subordination of snakes in the discrete setup. More precisely, given a random walk $W$ indexed by a tree $T$ and with steps in $\{...,-1,0,1\}$, we consider its subordinate tree obtained by contracting every edge of $T$ that does not lead to a new record of the walk $W$. When the underlying tree $T$ is a Bienaymé-Galton-Watson tree, we characterize the distribution of this subordinate tree.
